description: Open times for a 30-minute Tabflows demo, soonest first. demo picks which of the two demos tabflows.com/demo offers. "free-tools-demo", the default: a tour of the free Tabflows tools and a look at what we can automate. "automated-business-demo": the person brings one workflow, we build it live on their tools, then talk about a 2-week paid proof of concept. Every start time is a UTC ISO timestamp, whatever timezone is passed. An answer lists at most 20 times: start sets a later date to read from, and when truncated is true, nextStart is the start that returns the times after the cut. timezone is the person's IANA timezone: a start date is read in it, and the same timezone passed to book_demo sets the time zone of the booking and the invitation. Availability changes between calls, so times from an earlier answer may no longer be open.

start.description: Earliest time to list: a YYYY-MM-DD date read in timezone, or the nextStart of an earlier answer. Defaults to now.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the times are read in, e.g. "America/New_York"

name: get_demo_availability
title: Get open Tabflows demo times
